title: Manager at Electronics Component Distributor Expects Micron-Related Business to Grow Amid Supply Constraints
expert: Manager at an independent electronics component distributor (current); Micron >20% of team sales
verdict: An independent distributor fills only 40%–50% of Micron requests while supplier prices are up about 30% y/y and open-market prices up to 100%, with Micron sales +5%–10% y/y.

Spot vs contract DRAM pricing: 🟢 Supplier prices up about 30% y/y, independent market up to 100% (first-hand) vs the integrator's 55%–60% y/y paid (2026-11-06 call): spread between channels widening. → Tenet 4 (pricing durable) ↑
Supply & lead times: 🟢 Fill rate 40%–50% on Micron requests (first-hand) vs the integrator's 91%–92% (2026-11-06 call): the open market is far tighter than contract buyers. → Tenet 1 (supply short) ↑
🟢 HBM lead times 24–30 weeks vs 18–24 previously (first-hand) vs TrendForce DRAM lead times 19 weeks (SB #65604): conflicting. → Tenet 1 (supply short) ↑
🟡 Micron sales +5%–10% y/y Sept–Nov, backlog down 15%–20% as stock cannot be secured; +15%–20% expected Dec–Feb (estimate). → Tenet 2 (AI demand) ↑
CXMT/YMTC trajectory + US policy: 🔴 4–5 European customers moved about 10% of business to YMTC/CXMT on cost and supply (first-hand) vs the integrator's China suppliers at 7%–8% of purchases (2026-11-06 call): similar.

changes: Fill rate 40%–50% vs the integrator's 91%–92% (2026-11-06 call): independent channel far tighter than contract buyers.
HBM lead times 24–30 weeks vs 18–24 previously (expert) and integrator's 6 to 10 months (2026-11-06 call); TrendForce DRAM lead times 19 weeks (SB #65604): conflicting.
Supplier prices +30% y/y vs integrator's 55%–60% y/y paid (2026-11-06 call): lower at the supplier level; open market up to 100%.
Share to YMTC/CXMT about 10% for 4–5 customers vs integrator's China suppliers 7%–8% of purchases (2026-11-06 call): similar.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (supply short through 2028): ↑ — 40%–50% fill rates and HBM lead times 24–30 weeks, up from 18–24.
Tenet 2 (AI demand outruns supply): ↑ — backlog down 15%–20% only because stock cannot be secured; +15%–20% expected Dec–Feb.
Tenet 3 (SCAs): → — independent channel has no multi-year agreements; allocation is first-come, first-served.
Tenet 4 (pricing durable, RoC peaked): ↑ — supplier prices +30% y/y and open market up to 100%.
